findings.title: The client now rejects uploads over 10 MB regardless of configured limits
findings.body: This replaces the per-type configured limit with a fixed 10 MB limit for every upload. Sites that permit attachments or images larger than 10 MB will have those uploads rejected in the browser even though the server accepts them, so the client and server no longer honor the configured upload-size contract.

findings.title: Large GIF uploads can lose animation during downsizing
findings.body: When a GIF exceeds the configured size, this call preserves animation only when `allow_animated_thumbnails` is enabled. Otherwise the non-animated conversion path processes the first frame, so the saved upload can silently become a static image. Thumbnail animation policy should not determine whether the uploaded original retains its animation.
